content: We Work Remotely: Remote jobs in design, programming, marketing and more https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs.rss We Work Remotely: Remote jobs in design, programming, marketing and more en-US 60 OnTheGoSystems: Head of Marketing Anywhere in the World Nevada Digital Marketing, AI Research, Content Creation, Content Strategy, and AI Agents Sales and Marketing Full-Time <img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0171/2344/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" /> <p> <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="http://onthegosystems.com">http://onthegosystems.com</a> </p> <p>At <strong>OnTheGoSystems</strong> (creators of <a href="https://wpml.org/">WPML</a> and <a href="https://ptc.wpml.org/">PTC</a>), content is a key driver of how hundreds of thousands of people discover, understand, and choose our translation and localization products.</p> <p>AI is already a core part of how we work. We use it to move faster, automate work, research, analyze, build, and improve our products and processes.</p> <p>We’re looking for <strong>a hands-on marketer</strong> who works the same way. We’re looking for someone who uses AI agents, automation, integrations, and structured workflows to get real marketing work done – and can show us the results.</p> <p>You won’t be joining to follow a fixed marketing playbook. You’ll have the opportunity to bring your ideas and help shape how marketing works at OTGS, reaching hundreds of thousands of users worldwide.</p> <h2>What You’ll Do</h2> <ul> <li> <p>Find marketing and growth opportunities and turn them into concrete actions.</p> </li> <li> <p>Work hands-on across content, SEO/GEO, email, product marketing, acquisition, conversion, and other areas where you can make an impact.</p> </li> <li> <p>Use AI agents and automation as a core part of your everyday work.</p> </li> <li> <p>Build and improve workflows that help us achieve more with AI.</p> </li> <li> <p>Use data and business results to understand what works, what doesn’t, and what we should improve.</p> </li> <li> <p>Work directly with product, development, and support teams to understand our products, customers, and opportunities.</p> </li> <li> <p>Take ownership from identifying an opportunity through execution, measurement, and improvement.</p> </li> </ul> <h2>What We’re Looking For</h2> <ul> <li> <p>You already use AI agents, automation, or advanced AI workflows in your everyday work, own the quality of what they produce, and can show us the results.</p> </li> <li> <p>You adapt quickly when priorities change and can work effectively even when not everything is clearly defined from the beginning.</p> </li> <li> <p>You combine strategic thinking with strong hands-on execution. You can identify what needs to be done and turn ideas into action.</p> </li> <li> <p>You understand how marketing connects to business results and can share specific examples of your impact.</p> </li> <li> <p>You enjoy working across different areas of marketing, wearing different hats, and learning new things as needed.</p> </li> <li> <p>You have experience marketing technical products. A background in software, SaaS, WordPress, or a similar industry would be especially relevant.</p> </li> <li> <p>You work independently, make decisions, and move things forward without needing detailed instructions.</p> </li> </ul> <h2>Why Join Us</h2> <ul> <li> <p>We’re a profitable, self-funded product company growing since 2007.</p> </li> <li> <p>WPML powers more than 1.5 million websites worldwide, giving you a large audience to work with.</p> </li> <li> <p>Your work will directly influence how people discover our products, understand their value, and choose to use them.</p> </li> <li> <p>You’ll have real ownership and the freedom to shape our marketing approach, not simply execute an existing plan.</p> </li> <li> <p>You’ll work closely with product, engineering, support, and marketing teams, with direct access to the people building and supporting our products.</p> </li> <li> <p>You’ll have the opportunity to rethink how marketing can work with AI and turn your ideas into real workflows and results.</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Bring your ideas, build with AI, and help shape how we reach hundreds of thousands of users worldwide.</strong></p> <p><strong>Ready to show us what AI-native marketing can look like?
